description: The local kill switch (SEC-15, FR-33, T-23): the data file `kill` (`kill.php` on H1, after the data-file marker), written by `php moat-gate.php kill|revive` or by hand. `file`: `absent`, `damaged` (exists but has no marker, or cannot be read) or `{content}` = the text after the marker. `expect`: `gate` true = every request gets `gate_disabled`; `routes` = route names that get `route_disabled` (sorted, once each). One entry per line: `gate` or `route <name>` (name as in moat.yaml); blank lines and `#` comments are ignored, spaces, tabs and `` around a line too. Any other line switches the whole gate off, as does a damaged file: the switch fails closed.

cases.name: no kill file: nothing is off
several routes, sorted and once each

file.content:
route status
route newsletter
route status

cases.name: an empty kill file (marker only): nothing is off
comments, blank lines and CRLF are ignored

file.content:
# switched off by Eme

  route newsletter

cases.name: a route that is not in the bundle is listed and switches nothing else off
an unknown line switches the whole gate off
an upper-case route name is unknown: whole gate off
two spaces after route: whole gate off
route without a name: whole gate off
GATE in capitals: whole gate off
a route name longer than 63 characters: whole gate off
a file without the data-file marker (an empty file uploaded by hand): whole gate off
